model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots comparing training rewards over steps for two different training sets: "Easy Training Set" and "Hard Training Set". Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Steps", which ranges from 0 to 500 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis in both plots is labeled "Training Rewards" and uses a linear scale; in the top plot, it ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 with tick marks every 0.1, while in the bottom plot, it ranges from 0.0 to 0.2 with tick marks every 0.05. In the top plot, the teal line (Llama-On-Policy-Easy) and the red line (Llama-LUFFY-Easy) both start at 0.0 and increase over steps, reaching approximately 0.35 and 0.40 respectively by step 500, with the red line consistently slightly above the teal line after step 100. In the bottom plot, the teal line (Llama-On-Policy-Hard) starts at 0.0, rises to about 0.05 by step 50, then declines to near 0.0 by step 100 and remains flat. The red line (Llama-LUFFY-Hard) also starts at 0.0, increases to around 0.1 by step 100, continues to rise with fluctuations, and reaches approximately 0.2 by step 500.
